description: Zone-1 daily-fortune card must FAITHFULLY render the fortune, not just colour it. Cross-oracle adversary (2026-07-25, run-proven) proved the bug-class has >1 facet the verdict-colour anchor was blind to: (too) hardcoded grade='A' pct=99 sailed through the colour gate GREEN because colour is blind to DATA-binding; (goo รู1) out-of-range pct=150 overflows the label the colour gate never reads; (goo รู2) empty facets render a bare icon. Fix = clamp pct at the component (arc AND label) + graceful '—' chip fallback + widened anchor that reads the RENDERED text (glyphs the user sees, not source/data-attrs). Teeth-proven (run-fortune-fidelity.ts, neg-control-first): clean good A/88 · neutral C+/62 · caution D/34 (data-bound, distinct); mut=hardcode -> collapse+mismatch CAUGHT; unclamped 150% -> bounds gate rejects >100 CAUGHT; blanked chip -> empty gate rejects zero-length CAUGHT; real overflow clamps to 100%, real empty renders '—'. gate_layer=visual/rendered-text. Cross-lens division (none self-certifies): too=no hardcoded literal (static/AST) · goo=pct in [0,100] + facets non-empty at source (fortune-fields-complete) · me=colour[run-verdict-color] + data-binding/bounds/empty-fallback[here]. ⚠️ enforced_by REMOVED 2026-08-07 (goo · harness-tidy ใบ ข · on บอง’s ruling): the anchor named here was MOVED to harness/archive/ — nothing runs it (not CI, not an npm script), so the field was advertising a guard that does not run (the shape ตู๋ caught in #189/#191). Rule: connect it or withdraw the claim, never leave the claim standing. The anchor FILE is kept in harness/archive/ (Rule 1 · Nothing is Deleted); to revive, wire it into CI first, then re-add enforced_by. WAS: harness/run-fortune-fidelity.ts#mut=hardcode
